book.name: Korɛ̃ntitaamba sɛbɛdĩɛlãŋo
book.title: Polŋ nyɛgãaŋ sɛbɛdĩɛlãŋo maŋ hã Korɛ̃ntitaamba‑i

content: Tobiŋ namaa, muɔ miŋ bi kãa na terieŋgu-na da mi ka waŋ Diiloŋ-kusũŋgu‑i baa-na, mi saa ka piiye pigãaŋ wuɔ muɔmɛi suyaaŋ mi piiye mi yaŋ nuɔmba‑i hiere, mi saa bi ka piiye pigãaŋ wuɔ muɔmɛi suyaaŋ yiɛŋgu mi yaŋ-ba.
Mii naa waŋ-ma aa yiɛra-mɛi wuɔ baŋ gbuu Yesu-Kirsa maŋ *daaŋgu-na ko-yo, mi kã ka waŋ fuɔ maama yaa yoŋ baa-na, mi siɛ haa manamma mɛi.
Miŋ taa mi kã na terieŋgu-na, fɔ̃ŋgũɔ saa waa-miɛ aa korma naa ce mi kũɔma ta ma nyɛŋ.
Miŋ kãa, mi saa ka puur-na baa neldɔdɔlma na da na cu mi huoŋ-nu ŋaa nuɔmbaŋ puur ba-naa dumaa, ŋga *Diiloŋ-Yalle himma yaa ciɛ na siɛ mi nelma‑i.
A ce dumaaŋo-na, naŋ hũyãa Yesu maama‑i ku saa ce ŋaa nelbilieŋ-cɛ̃cɛ̃muŋgu'i ciɛ na hũu-ma, ŋga Diiloŋ-himma yaa ciɛ na hũu-ma.

Bamaŋ naaŋ kaasĩnni Diiloŋ-hũmelle-na i hãalã-bɛi nelnulle. Ŋga nelnulle fande‑i diiduɔle sĩ baa nelbiliemba diele‑i, diiduɔle bi sĩ baa miwaaŋ daayo yuntaamba diele‑i. Bafamba yuntesĩnni sa cɔ.

I pigãaŋ nuɔmba‑i Diiloŋ-nelnulle. Diiloŋo kusũŋgu maŋ fuyaa nelbiliemba-na, i hãalã nuɔmba‑i ku yaa‑i. Aa miwaaŋo suɔ duɔ doŋ, Diiloŋo naa yiɛra-mɛi duɔ pigãaŋ-ye u kusũŋgu‑i i diɛ ji tiɛ ce i bãaŋgu‑i baa-yo.
Diiloŋo kusũŋ daaku‑i miwaaŋo yuntaamba sa suɔ-ku. Kuɔ ba taa ba suɔ-ku, baa naa saa gbu yuntaamba Yuntieŋo‑i *daaŋgu-na ko-yo.
Ŋga ma ciɛ ŋaa maŋ nyɛgãaŋ dumaa Diiloŋ-nelma-na wuɔ:

content.text: «Moloŋ yufelleŋ'a di saa haa kumaŋ nuɔ‑i dede,
kumaŋ maama‑i saa suur nɛliɛŋ tũŋ-nu dede,
kumaŋ molo saa jɔguɔŋ ku maama dede,
Diiloŋo tigiiŋ ku yaa‑i a hã u maamaŋ dɔlnuŋ bamaŋ.»

content: Bĩŋkũŋgu faŋgu‑i, Diiloŋo ciɛ u *Yalle pigãaŋ miɛmɛi baa-ku. *Diiloŋ-Yalle suɔ nelma‑i hiere; halle di suɔ Diiloŋo huɔya-maama‑i.
Hai moloŋo‑i gbãa suɔ u nanolŋo kusũŋ-maama‑i ji cor kutieŋ fuɔ fɛrɛ‑i? Ku yaa ŋaa Diiloŋo kũŋgu‑i: Da ma hel u Yalle-na, molo siɛ gbãa suɔ u kusũŋgu‑i.
A ne da miɛ iŋ daa Yalle maŋ, nelbilieŋ diele sĩ, Diiloŋ diele. U hãa-ye baa-de i diɛ suɔ uŋ ciɛ ãnfafamma maŋ yiɛ hiere.

Ãnfafaŋ daama‑i, diɛ i waŋ ma maama‑i, i sa waŋ-ma baa miɛ cɛ̃cɛ̃muŋgu, i waŋ-ma baa nelma maŋ Diiloŋ-Yalleŋ hãalãayã-yiɛ baa-ma. A ce dumaaŋo-na, i waŋ Diiloŋ-Yalle maama‑i baa Diiloŋ-Yalleŋ yeŋ bamaŋ nuɔ‑i.
Nelbiloŋ nuɔŋo‑i ŋ yundaaŋgu‑i, ŋ siɛ gbãa hũu Diiloŋ-Yalle maama‑i. Diiloŋ-Yalleŋ'a di si dii ŋ huɔŋga-na, ma maaraa-ni ŋ suɔ ma yaaŋga‑i. Da ŋ nu-ma, ŋ da-ma miminsĩnni.
Diiloŋ-Yal da di waa umaŋ nuɔ‑i, u gbãa suɔ nelma‑i hiere ma yaaŋga‑i, a ne da fuɔŋ ceŋ mamaŋ, nelgbãŋgbãlãaŋ siɛ gbãa suɔ ma yaaŋga‑i.
Na saa da, ma nyɛgãaŋ Diiloŋ-nelma-na wuɔ:
